sourceQuote: Weifang Universityoffers more than just programs which are commonly provided in other universities. Courses, such as Chinese language, culture, and ways to do business in China are introduced to increase the competitive advantages of our students.
targetQuote: 潍坊学院提供的不仅仅是其他高校普遍设置的课程，还引入了中国语言、文化及在中国开展业务的方法等课程，以提升学生的竞争优势。
